items.q: I mean he’s a dear friend. His daughter is my Goddaughter, we’ve been buddies forever, a phenomenal player.

ctx.x: When you know it, when you’ve played it for two years without music, then you’ve got it. So they realize it’s many, many years, since man existed they were making music I’m sure. I was telling, cavemen, they were making “rock” music then. And so they start getting it. You do all these things and like they start just really, and sometimes I’ll like set up — oh this last one was so beautiful — just when I happened to be in the room, I’ll set up like a tenor, a bari — maybe two tenors, a bari and a trombone over…

at a high school in New Jersey. And I couldn’t get her at first to just like play without the music without going to something that she hadn’t memorized. So now this was actually before the cheese or anything. And I said, “Come on let’s sit on the floor.” We sat on the floor with the piano behind us, and just put one hand up there and hit one note, and act like you’ve never heard a piano in your life, it would be just like a baby hearing the first note. Bing. And after a half hour of that she just started opening…
